back_squat.name: Back squat
back_squat.instructions: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width. Sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least parallel, chest up, knees tracking over your toes. Drive up through the whole foot.
mistakes: Knees caving in on the way up
Cutting depth as the weight goes up

front_squat.name: Front squat
front_squat.instructions: Bar resting on the front of your shoulders, elbows high. Squat straight down keeping your torso upright, then stand up without letting the elbows drop.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet_squat.instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest. Squat down between your knees, elbows inside the knees, chest tall, then stand up.
mistakes: Letting the weight drift away from the body

leg_press.name: Leg press
leg_press.instructions: Feet hip-width in the middle of the platform. Lower until your knees are at about 90°, keep your lower back on the pad, press back up without locking the knees.
cues: Lower back stays on the pad
Stop just short of locking out
mistakes: Hips curling off the seat at the bottom

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweight_squat.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, arms forward for balance. Sit back and down as deep as you can with a flat back, then stand up tall.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom

split_squat.name: Split squat
split_squat.instructions: Long stride stance. Lower the back knee straight down towards the floor, front shin roughly vertical, then push up through the front foot. Switch legs after the set.

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian_split_squat.instructions: Rear foot on a bench behind you. Lower until the front thigh is about parallel, torso slightly forward, then drive up through the front heel.
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench

deadlift.name: Deadlift
deadlift.instructions: Bar over mid-foot, hip-width stance. Hinge to grip the bar, flat back, shoulders over the bar. Push the floor away and stand up tall, then lower with control.
cues: Bar stays in contact with the legs
Brace, then push the floor away
mistakes: Bar drifting away from the shins
Jerking the bar off the floor

romanian_deadlift.name: Romanian deadlift
romanian_deadlift.instructions: Stand tall with the weight. Push your hips back with soft knees, sliding the weight down your thighs until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then drive the hips forward.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat
Rounding the back to go lower

single_leg_rdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
single_leg_rdl.instructions: Stand on one leg. Hinge forward while the free leg reaches back, hips square, back flat. Return to standing by squeezing the glute of the standing leg.
cues: Hips stay square to the floor
Reach back with the free heel
Soft knee on the standing leg
mistakes: Opening the hip to the side

hip_thrust.name: Hip thrust
hip_thrust.instructions: Upper back on a bench, weight across your hips, feet flat. Drive the hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, lower with control.
cues: Squeeze the glutes for a second
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
Feet too far away so hamstrings take over

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Press through your heels and lift the hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up, squeeze, then lower.
mistakes: Feet too far from the hips

kettlebell_swing.name: Kettlebell swing
kettlebell_swing.instructions: Hike the bell back between your legs, then snap the hips forward to float it to chest height. Power comes from the hips, not the arms.
cues: Hike it back high between the legs

good_morning.name: Good morning
good_morning.instructions: Bar on your upper back, soft knees. Push the hips back and lower your torso with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings, then return to standing.
cues: Hips back as the chest goes down
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat

walking_lunge.name: Walking lunge
walking_lunge.instructions: Step forward into a lunge, back knee close to the floor, then step through into the next lunge with the other leg. Keep your torso upright.
cues: Back knee close to the floor
mistakes: Pushing mostly off the back foot

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.instructions: Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor. Push through the front foot to return. Alternate legs or finish one side first.
cues: Most weight on the front foot
Drive up through the front heel

step_up.name: Step-up
step_up.instructions: Place one foot fully on a box or bench. Drive through that foot to stand up on top without pushing off the back leg, then step down slowly.
cues: Stand up with the top leg only

lateral_lunge.name: Lateral lunge
lateral_lunge.instructions: Take a wide step to the side and sit into that hip, keeping the other leg straight and both feet flat. Push back to the start.
mistakes: Knee shooting past the toes inward

pistol_squat_progression.name: Pistol squat progression
pistol_squat_progression.instructions: Stand on one leg, the other leg forward. Squat down as far as you control – to a box or holding a support at first – then stand up.
cues: Use a box or support first

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing calf raise
standing_calf_raise.instructions: Balls of your feet on a step. Rise as high as you can, pause, then lower the heels slowly below the step.

bent_knee_calf_raise.name: Bent-knee calf raise
bent_knee_calf_raise.instructions: Same as a calf raise but with the knees bent about 30°, which targets the soleus – important for runners.
mistakes: Rolling to the outside of the foot

tibialis_raise.name: Tibialis raise
tibialis_raise.instructions: Lean your back against a wall, heels about a foot away. Lift your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.
cues: Lift the toes as high as possible
mistakes: Heels too close to the wall

single_leg_hops.name: Single-leg hops in place
single_leg_hops.instructions: Small, quick hops on one foot staying on the ball of the foot, knee slightly bent. Stay springy and quiet.
cues: Stay on the ball of the foot

bench_press.name: Bench press
bench_press.instructions: Lie on the bench, eyes under the bar, shoulder blades squeezed together. Lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press it back up.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest

dumbbell_press.name: Dumbbell press
dumbbell_press.instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest. Lower them to chest level, elbows at about 45°, then press up.

incline_press.name: Incline press
incline_press.instructions: Bench set to 30–45°. Lower the weight to your upper chest and press it back up over your shoulders.
mistakes: Bench too steep so it becomes a shoulder press

push_up.name: Push-up
push_up.instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up.

feet_elevated_push_up.name: Feet-elevated push-up
feet_elevated_push_up.instructions: Like a push-up with your feet on a bench or chair. Keep the body straight and lower your chest towards the floor.

archer_push_up.name: Archer push-up
archer_push_up.instructions: Very wide hands. Lower towards one hand while the other arm stays almost straight, push back up and alternate sides.

dips.name: Dips
dips.instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or a sturdy bench. Lower until your shoulders are just below the elbows, then press back up.
cues: Shoulders down, away from the ears
Lower to just below the elbows

overhead_press.name: Overhead press
overhead_press.instructions: Bar on the front of your shoulders, glutes and core tight. Press straight overhead, moving your head back slightly, finish with arms locked.

dumbbell_shoulder_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell_shoulder_press.instructions: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height. Press them overhead until the arms are straight, then lower with control.

pike_push_up.name: Pike push-up
pike_push_up.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V. Bend the elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor, then push back up.
cues: Head to a point in front of the hands
mistakes: Hips dropping into a regular push-up
Head going straight down between the hands

lateral_raise.name: Lateral raise
lateral_raise.instructions: Light dumbbells at your sides. Raise them out to shoulder height with slightly bent elbows, then lower slowly.

barbell_row.name: Barbell row
barbell_row.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back. Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower with control.
mistakes: Standing up more with each rep

dumbbell_row.name: Dumbbell row
dumbbell_row.instructions: One hand and knee on a bench. Pull the dumbbell towards your hip, elbow close to the body, then lower fully.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated cable row
seated_cable_row.instructions: Sit tall with a slight knee bend. Pull the handle to your stomach, shoulders down and back, then let the arms extend slowly.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth

inverted_row.name: Inverted row
inverted_row.instructions: Hang under a bar or sturdy table, body straight, heels on the floor. Pull your chest to the bar, then lower with control.

face_pull.name: Face pull
face_pull.instructions: Rope or band at face height. Pull towards your forehead, elbows high and wide, then return slowly.
cues: Rotate the hands back at the end
mistakes: Leaning back to move the weight

pull_up.name: Pull-up
pull_up.instructions: Hang with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Pull your chest towards the bar, then lower all the way with control.

chin_up.name: Chin-up
chin_up.instructions: Like a pull-up with palms facing you and hands shoulder-width. Pull your chin over the bar.
cues: Elbows drive down to the ribs

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat_pulldown.instructions: Sit with thighs under the pad. Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with the elbows, then let it rise slowly.
mistakes: Leaning far back to use momentum

band_assisted_pull_up.name: Band-assisted pull-up
band_assisted_pull_up.instructions: Loop a band over the bar and put a knee or foot in it. Do pull-ups with the band's help; use lighter bands as you get stronger.
cues: Use a lighter band over time
mistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom with the band

biceps_curl.name: Biceps curl
biceps_curl.instructions: Elbows by your sides. Curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze, then lower slowly.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer curl
hammer_curl.instructions: Like a biceps curl with palms facing each other throughout.

triceps_pushdown.name: Triceps pushdown
triceps_pushdown.instructions: At a cable station, elbows pinned to your sides. Push the bar or rope down until the arms are straight, then let it rise.

overhead_triceps_extension.name: Overhead triceps extension
overhead_triceps_extension.instructions: Hold one weight overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows, then extend back up.

plank.name: Plank
plank.instructions: Forearms under your shoulders, body straight from head to heels. Brace your stomach and hold without letting the hips sag.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.instructions: On one forearm, feet stacked. Lift the hips so your body forms a straight line and hold. Switch sides.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.instructions: On your back, arms up, knees over hips. Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back on the floor, then switch.
cues: Lower back stays on the floor

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.instructions: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until straight. Hold briefly, keep the hips level, switch sides.

pallof_press.name: Pallof press
pallof_press.instructions: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height. Press the handle straight out and resist the pull to rotate, then bring it back.

hanging_knee_raise.name: Hanging knee raise
hanging_knee_raise.instructions: Hang from a bar. Raise your knees towards your chest without swinging, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Only lifting the knees without curling the pelvis

copenhagen_plank.name: Copenhagen plank
copenhagen_plank.instructions: Side plank with the top leg on a bench and the bottom leg free. Hold the hips up – a strong exercise for the adductors.
cues: Start with the knee on the bench
mistakes: Going straight to the long-lever version

ab_wheel.name: Ab wheel rollout
ab_wheel.instructions: Kneel holding the wheel. Roll forward as far as you can keep your back flat, then pull back using your core.
cues: Roll only as far as the back stays flat
mistakes: Bending at the hips to return

pogo_hops.name: Pogo hops
pogo_hops.instructions: Quick, small two-footed jumps on the balls of your feet with stiff ankles, minimal ground contact time.

box_jump.name: Box jump
box_jump.instructions: Swing your arms and jump onto a box, landing softly in a quarter squat. Step down – don't jump down.
cues: Land softly in a quarter squat
mistakes: Box too high so you land in a deep squat

broad_jump.name: Broad jump
broad_jump.instructions: Swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can, landing softly on both feet. Reset before each jump.

bounding.name: Bounding
bounding.instructions: Exaggerated running strides: drive the knee up and push off powerfully, spending as long as possible in the air.

a_skips.name: A-skips
a_skips.instructions: Skip forward lifting one knee to hip height while the other foot strikes the ground under your hips. Rhythmic and light.
mistakes: Landing in front of the body

hip_flexor_stretch.name: Hip flexor stretch
hip_flexor_stretch.instructions: Half-kneeling, tuck your pelvis and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip. Hold, then switch.

ankle_dorsiflexion.name: Ankle dorsiflexion
ankle_dorsiflexion.instructions: Half-kneeling facing a wall. Drive the front knee towards the wall without lifting the heel, then return.

thoracic_rotation.name: Thoracic rotation
thoracic_rotation.instructions: On all fours, one hand behind your head. Rotate the elbow down and then up towards the ceiling, following it with your eyes.
cues: Follow the elbow with the eyes

hips_90_90.name: 90/90 hips
hips_90_90.instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90°, one in front, one to the side. Rotate the knees to the other side without using your hands.

hamstring_floss.name: Hamstring floss
hamstring_floss.instructions: Lie on your back holding one leg behind the thigh. Straighten and bend the knee slowly while pointing and flexing the foot.

leg_extension.name: Leg extension
leg_extension.instructions: Line your knee joint up with the machine pivot and set the shin pad just above the ankles. Straighten the legs until the knees are fully extended, pause, then lower under control.
cues: Knees line up with the pivot
Lower for two to three seconds
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat

seated_leg_curl.name: Seated leg curl
seated_leg_curl.instructions: Knees in line with the pivot, the thigh pad locked down firmly, the lower pad just above the heels. Pull the heels down and under the seat, pause, then let the legs extend slowly.
cues: Thigh pad tight on the legs
mistakes: Hips sliding forward on the seat

lying_leg_curl.name: Lying leg curl
lying_leg_curl.instructions: Lie face down with the knees just off the bench and the pad above the heels. Curl the heels towards the glutes while keeping the hips pressed down, then lower slowly.

standing_leg_curl.name: Standing leg curl
standing_leg_curl.instructions: Stand facing the machine with one leg behind the pad. Curl the heel up towards the glute, keeping the thigh still, then lower slowly. Finish one side before switching.
mistakes: Leaning on the machine to help

hip_abduction_machine.name: Hip abduction machine
hip_abduction_machine.instructions: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees. Push the legs apart as far as you control, pause, then let them come back together slowly.
cues: Sit tall against the back rest

hip_adduction_machine.name: Hip adduction machine
hip_adduction_machine.instructions: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees, starting at a comfortable stretch. Squeeze the legs together, pause, then open them slowly.

hack_squat.name: Hack squat
hack_squat.instructions: Back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform. Unlock, squat down until the thighs are at least parallel, then drive back up through the whole foot.
mistakes: Locking out hard at the top

belt_squat.name: Belt squat
belt_squat.instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform. Squat down with an upright torso, then stand up. The load sits on the hips, not the spine.

smith_squat.name: Smith machine squat
smith_squat.instructions: Bar on your upper back in the Smith machine, feet slightly in front of the bar. Unlock the hooks, squat down with control and stand back up.
mistakes: Forgetting where the safety stops are

seated_leg_press.name: Seated leg press
seated_leg_press.instructions: Sit with the back against the pad and feet hip-width on the platform. Bend the knees towards your chest, then press out until the legs are almost straight.
cues: Feet in the middle of the platform
mistakes: Lower back rounding at the bottom

single_leg_press.name: Single-leg press
single_leg_press.instructions: Set up as for the leg press with one foot in the middle of the platform. Lower under control and press back up. Use a lighter weight than for both legs.
mistakes: Going too deep and rounding the back

glute_kickback_machine.name: Glute kickback machine
glute_kickback_machine.instructions: Set up on the machine with the working foot on the plate or pad. Drive the leg back by squeezing the glute, without arching the lower back, then return slowly.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the end

hip_thrust_machine.name: Hip thrust machine
hip_thrust_machine.instructions: Sit with the belt or pad across your hips and upper back against the pad. Drive the hips up until the body is straight from shoulders to knees, pause, lower with control.

seated_calf_raise.name: Seated calf raise
seated_calf_raise.instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Lower the heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.

leg_press_calf_raise.name: Leg press calf raise
leg_press_calf_raise.instructions: On the leg press, put the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, legs almost straight. Push the platform away with your toes, then let the heels come back for a stretch.
cues: Keep the safety handles in reach

back_extension_machine.name: Back extension machine
back_extension_machine.instructions: Sit with the pad on your upper back and the hips fixed by the belt or pads. Extend the back slowly against the resistance to an upright position, then return with control.

hyperextension.name: Back extension
hyperextension.instructions: On a 45° back extension bench, the pad just below the hip bones. Hinge forward with a flat back, then rise until your body is in a straight line. Hold a plate for more load.
cues: Squeeze the glutes to come up
mistakes: Pad too high so the hips cannot hinge

reverse_hyperextension.name: Reverse hyperextension
reverse_hyperextension.instructions: Lie face down on the bench with the hips at the edge and hold on. Lift the straight legs up to body level with the glutes, then lower with control.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest press machine
chest_press_machine.instructions: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height. Shoulder blades back against the pad, press the handles forward until the arms are almost straight, then return slowly.
mistakes: Seat too low or too high

incline_chest_press_machine.name: Incline chest press machine
incline_chest_press_machine.instructions: Sit with the handles at upper-chest height. Press up and forward, keeping the shoulder blades back, then lower with control.

decline_chest_press_machine.name: Decline chest press machine
decline_chest_press_machine.instructions: Sit tall with the handles at lower-chest height. Press forward and slightly down until the arms are almost straight, then return slowly.

pec_deck.name: Pec deck
pec_deck.instructions: Sit tall with the handles or pads at chest height, elbows slightly bent. Bring the arms together in an arc in front of the chest, squeeze, then open slowly to a comfortable stretch.
cues: Open only to a comfortable stretch
mistakes: Opening too far behind the body

rear_delt_fly_machine.name: Reverse fly machine
rear_delt_fly_machine.instructions: Sit facing the pad, handles at shoulder height. Push the arms back and out in a wide arc with slightly bent elbows, pause, then return slowly.
cues: Lead with the back of the hands
mistakes: Pulling with the arms like a row

shoulder_press_machine.name: Shoulder press machine
shoulder_press_machine.instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at about shoulder height. Press up until the arms are straight without locking hard, then lower under control.
mistakes: Seat set too high for full range

lateral_raise_machine.name: Lateral raise machine
lateral_raise_machine.instructions: Sit with the pads on the outside of your upper arms. Raise the arms out to the side to shoulder height, pause, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Going above shoulder height with a heavy load

seated_row_machine.name: Seated row machine
seated_row_machine.instructions: Chest against the pad, handles at arm's length. Pull the elbows back past the body, squeeze the shoulder blades, then let the arms extend fully.
mistakes: Leaving the chest pad to jerk the weight

t_bar_row.name: T-bar row
t_bar_row.instructions: On a T-bar station or with a landmine handle, hinge forward with a flat back or lie on the chest pad. Pull the handle to the lower chest, then lower with control.
cues: Flat back or chest on the pad

high_row_machine.name: High row machine
high_row_machine.instructions: Sit with the thighs under the pad and grab the handles above and in front of you. Pull down and back towards the chest, elbows wide, then return slowly.
mistakes: Letting the handles yank the arms up

machine_pulldown.name: Machine pulldown
machine_pulldown.instructions: Sit with the thighs under the pad and grab the handles overhead. Drive the elbows down towards the ribs, then let the arms rise to a full stretch.
mistakes: Pulling with the hands instead of the elbows

assisted_pull_up_machine.name: Assisted pull-up machine
assisted_pull_up_machine.instructions: Kneel or stand on the platform; the selected weight helps you up. Pull until the chin is over the handles, then lower all the way. Less assistance means harder.
mistakes: Too much assistance for too long

assisted_dip_machine.name: Assisted dip machine
assisted_dip_machine.instructions: Kneel on the platform and grip the dip handles. Lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows, then press up. Less assistance means harder.

pullover_machine.name: Pullover machine
pullover_machine.instructions: Sit with the elbows on the pads and the shoulders lined up with the pivot. Pull the elbows down in an arc towards the body, pause, then let them rise slowly to a full stretch.
cues: Shoulder in line with the pivot
Push with the elbows, not the hands
mistakes: Gripping hard and pulling with the arms

biceps_curl_machine.name: Biceps curl machine
biceps_curl_machine.instructions: Set the seat so the upper arms lie flat on the pad and the elbows line up with the pivot. Curl the handles up, squeeze, then lower to almost straight arms.
cues: Elbows in line with the pivot
Upper arms stay on the pad
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad

triceps_extension_machine.name: Triceps extension machine
triceps_extension_machine.instructions: Set the seat so the elbows line up with the pivot. Push the handles down or forward until the arms are straight, then return slowly.

seated_dip_machine.name: Seated dip machine
seated_dip_machine.instructions: Sit tall with the handles at your sides. Press them down until the arms are straight, keeping the shoulders down, then let them rise slowly.

ab_crunch_machine.name: Ab crunch machine
ab_crunch_machine.instructions: Sit with the pads on your chest or the handles by your head. Curl the ribs down towards the hips, pause, then return slowly.
cues: Curl the spine, do not hinge

torso_rotation_machine.name: Torso rotation machine
torso_rotation_machine.instructions: Sit with the legs or chest fixed and rotate your torso against the resistance through a comfortable range, then return slowly. Do both sides.

neck_extension_machine.name: Neck extension machine
neck_extension_machine.instructions: Sit with the back of your head against the pad. Slowly move the head back against the resistance to a neutral position, then return. Use a light weight.

neck_flexion_machine.name: Neck flexion machine
neck_flexion_machine.instructions: Sit with your forehead against the pad. Slowly bring the chin towards the chest against the resistance, then return. Use a light weight.
mistakes: Rounding the upper back to help

smith_bench_press.name: Smith machine bench press
smith_bench_press.instructions: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar so it lowers to mid-chest. Unlock, lower with control to the chest, press back up and rack the hooks.

smith_incline_press.name: Smith machine incline press
smith_incline_press.instructions: Set an incline bench at 30–45° under the Smith bar so it lowers to the upper chest. Lower with control, press up, rack safely.

smith_shoulder_press.name: Smith machine shoulder press
smith_shoulder_press.instructions: Sit on an upright bench under the Smith bar. Lower the bar to about chin height in front of the face, then press back up.
cues: Bar in front of the face

cable_fly.name: Cable fly
cable_fly.instructions: Set both pulleys high, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a split stance. Bring the hands together in front of the lower chest in a wide arc, then open slowly.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press

low_cable_fly.name: Low-to-high cable fly
low_cable_fly.instructions: Set both pulleys low. From a split stance, sweep the handles up and together to upper-chest height, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Turning it into a front raise

cable_chest_press.name: Standing cable chest press
cable_chest_press.instructions: Pulleys at chest height behind you, a handle in each hand, split stance. Press the handles forward and slightly together, then return with control.
cues: Do not let the cables pull you back

single_arm_cable_row.name: Single-arm cable row
single_arm_cable_row.instructions: Pulley at chest height or below, handle in one hand. Row the elbow back past the body, squeeze, then reach forward and let the shoulder blade move. Do both sides.
mistakes: Twisting a lot to move the weight

single_arm_lat_pulldown.name: Single-arm lat pulldown
single_arm_lat_pulldown.instructions: Kneel or sit under a high pulley with one handle. Pull the elbow down towards the hip, then let the arm rise to a full stretch. Do both sides.

straight_arm_pulldown.name: Straight-arm pulldown
straight_arm_pulldown.instructions: High pulley with a bar or rope. Hinge slightly, arms almost straight. Sweep the hands down to the thighs using the lats, then let them rise slowly.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown

cable_lateral_raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cable_lateral_raise.instructions: Low pulley, stand side-on and take the handle with the far hand. Raise the arm out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Do both sides.

cable_rear_delt_fly.name: Cable reverse fly
cable_rear_delt_fly.instructions: Pulleys at shoulder height, cross the cables and hold the left handle in the right hand and vice versa. Pull the arms out and back in a wide arc, then return slowly.

cable_front_raise.name: Cable front raise
cable_front_raise.instructions: Low pulley behind or between the feet, bar or rope in both hands. Raise the arms in front to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

cable_upright_row.name: Cable upright row
cable_upright_row.instructions: Low pulley with a bar or rope. Pull the handle up along the body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and slightly above the hands, then lower slowly.
cues: Wide grip is friendlier for the shoulders

cable_y_raise.name: Cable Y-raise
cable_y_raise.instructions: Low pulleys crossed in front of you. Raise the arms up and out into a Y above shoulder height, thumbs up, then lower slowly. Use a light weight.

cable_external_rotation.name: Cable external rotation
cable_external_rotation.instructions: Pulley at elbow height, stand side-on with the elbow tucked against the body at 90°. Rotate the forearm out away from the body, then return slowly. Do both sides.
mistakes: Elbow drifting away from the body

cable_curl.name: Cable curl
cable_curl.instructions: Low pulley with a bar. Elbows by your sides, curl the bar up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

rope_hammer_curl.name: Rope hammer curl
rope_hammer_curl.instructions: Low pulley with a rope. Thumbs up, curl the rope towards the shoulders, then lower slowly.

cable_overhead_triceps_extension.name: Cable overhead triceps extension
cable_overhead_triceps_extension.instructions: Rope on a high or low pulley, face away and hold the rope behind the head. Extend the arms forward and up until straight, then bend the elbows slowly for a deep stretch.

cable_triceps_kickback.name: Cable triceps kickback
cable_triceps_kickback.instructions: Low pulley, hinge forward with the upper arm parallel to the body. Extend the elbow until the arm is straight, then return slowly. Do both sides.

cable_shrug.name: Cable shrug
cable_shrug.instructions: Low pulley with a bar. Stand tall and lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears, pause, then lower fully.

cable_crunch.name: Cable crunch
cable_crunch.instructions: Kneel under a high pulley holding a rope beside your head. Curl the ribs down towards the hips, pause, then return slowly.

cable_woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cable_woodchop.instructions: High pulley, stand side-on. Pull the handle diagonally down across the body to the opposite hip, turning through the trunk, then return slowly. Do both sides.

cable_lift.name: Cable lift
cable_lift.instructions: Low pulley, stand side-on. Lift the handle diagonally from the low hip up across the body to above the opposite shoulder, then return slowly. Do both sides.
cues: Drive from the legs and trunk
mistakes: Arching the back at the top

cable_glute_kickback.name: Cable glute kickback
cable_glute_kickback.instructions: Ankle strap on a low pulley. Hold the frame, hinge slightly and drive the working leg back by squeezing the glute, then return slowly.

cable_pull_through.name: Cable pull-through
cable_pull_through.instructions: Low pulley with a rope between your legs, face away. Hinge back with soft knees, then drive the hips forward to stand tall and squeeze the glutes.

cable_hip_abduction.name: Cable hip abduction
cable_hip_abduction.instructions: Ankle strap on the far ankle, stand side-on to a low pulley. Lift the leg out to the side, then return slowly. Do both sides.

cable_hip_adduction.name: Cable hip adduction
cable_hip_adduction.instructions: Ankle strap on the near ankle, stand side-on to a low pulley. Bring the leg across in front of the standing leg, then return slowly. Do both sides.

trap_bar_deadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
trap_bar_deadlift.instructions: Stand inside the trap bar, grip the handles at your sides. Brace, push the floor away and stand up tall, then lower with control.

sumo_deadlift.name: Sumo deadlift
sumo_deadlift.instructions: Wide stance with the toes turned out, hands inside the knees. Push the knees out, brace and stand up with the bar close, then lower with control.

close_grip_bench_press.name: Close-grip bench press
close_grip_bench_press.instructions: Bench press with the hands about shoulder-width. Elbows stay close to the body as you lower to the lower chest, then press up.
mistakes: Grip too narrow so the wrists bend

landmine_press.name: Landmine press
landmine_press.instructions: One end of a barbell in a landmine or corner. Hold the other end at the shoulder and press it up and forward until the arm is straight, then lower. Do both sides.

upright_row.name: Upright row
upright_row.instructions: Hold the weight in front of the thighs with a grip wider than shoulder-width. Pull up along the body to lower-chest height, elbows leading, then lower slowly.

ez_bar_curl.name: EZ-bar curl
ez_bar_curl.instructions: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips, elbows by your sides. Curl up, squeeze, then lower slowly.

preacher_curl.name: Preacher curl
preacher_curl.instructions: Upper arms flat on the preacher pad. Curl the weight up, then lower until the arms are almost straight.
cues: Do not fully relax at the bottom
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad

skull_crusher.name: Skull crusher
skull_crusher.instructions: Lie on a bench holding the weight above the shoulders. Bend only the elbows to lower it towards the forehead or just behind the head, then extend.

dumbbell_fly.name: Dumbbell fly
dumbbell_fly.instructions: Lie on a flat or incline bench with dumbbells above the chest, palms facing. Open the arms in a wide arc with soft elbows to a comfortable stretch, then bring them back together.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press

arnold_press.name: Arnold press
arnold_press.instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while rotating the palms to face forward, then reverse on the way down.

shrug.name: Shrug
shrug.instructions: Hold the weights at your sides or in front. Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears, pause, then lower fully.

dumbbell_rear_delt_fly.name: Bent-over reverse fly
dumbbell_rear_delt_fly.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below the chest. Raise the arms out to the side with soft elbows, pause, then lower slowly.
cues: Lead with the back of the hands

dumbbell_pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
dumbbell_pullover.instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell above the chest with both hands. Lower it behind the head in an arc with soft elbows, then pull it back over the chest.

incline_dumbbell_curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline_dumbbell_curl.instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with the arms hanging straight down. Curl the dumbbells up without moving the upper arms, then lower slowly.

concentration_curl.name: Concentration curl
concentration_curl.instructions: Sit with the elbow braced against the inner thigh. Curl the dumbbell up, squeeze, then lower slowly. Do both sides.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow off the leg

chest_supported_dumbbell_row.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
chest_supported_dumbbell_row.instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging. Row the elbows back past the body, squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower fully.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench

farmer_carry.name: Farmer's carry
farmer_carry.instructions: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand and walk with short, quick steps, standing tall with the shoulders down. Put the weights down with a flat back.
mistakes: Rounding the back when picking up

suitcase_carry.name: Suitcase carry
suitcase_carry.instructions: Hold one heavy weight in one hand and walk tall without leaning towards it. Switch hands halfway.
mistakes: Leaning towards or away from the weight

nordic_curl.name: Nordic hamstring curl
nordic_curl.instructions: Kneel with the ankles anchored. Keeping hips and body straight, lower yourself forward as slowly as you can, catch yourself with the hands and push back up.
cues: Body straight from knees to head
Use the hands to come back up

hanging_leg_raise.name: Hanging leg raise
hanging_leg_raise.instructions: Hang from a bar and lift the straight legs to at least hip height, curling the pelvis up, then lower slowly.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent. Curl the head and shoulders off the floor by bringing the ribs towards the hips, then lower slowly.

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse_crunch.instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent at 90°. Curl the hips off the floor towards the ribs, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Arching the back on the way down

russian_twist.name: Russian twist
russian_twist.instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with a tall spine, feet on or off the floor. Rotate the torso side to side, touching the floor beside the hip.

hollow_hold.name: Hollow hold
hollow_hold.instructions: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor and lift the shoulders and legs a little. Hold the shape and breathe.
cues: Bend the knees to make it easier
mistakes: Legs too low for your strength

wall_sit.name: Wall sit
wall_sit.instructions: Slide down a wall until the knees are at about 90° and hold, back flat against the wall.

jump_squat.name: Jump squat
jump_squat.instructions: Squat down to a quarter or half squat, then jump as high as you can. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

lateral_bounds.name: Lateral bounds
lateral_bounds.instructions: Jump sideways from one leg to the other, landing softly and holding briefly before the next bound.

band_chest_fly.name: Band chest fly
band_chest_fly.instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height, or wrap it around your back, a handle in each hand. Bring the arms together in front of the chest in a wide arc, then open slowly.

band_pull_apart.name: Band pull-apart
band_pull_apart.instructions: Hold a band in front at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull the band apart until it touches the chest, then return slowly.

band_lateral_walk.name: Band lateral walk
band_lateral_walk.instructions: Band around the legs above the knees or at the ankles. In a quarter squat, step sideways keeping tension on the band. Walk both directions.

turkish_get_up.name: Turkish get-up
turkish_get_up.instructions: Lie down holding a weight straight up in one hand. Get up to standing in steps while keeping the arm vertical and your eyes on the weight, then reverse to the floor.
mistakes: Too heavy before the pattern is learned

worlds_greatest_stretch.name: Lunge with rotation
worlds_greatest_stretch.instructions: From a long lunge, put the inside hand on the floor, drop the elbow towards the front foot, then rotate the other arm to the ceiling. Do both sides.

cat_cow.name: Cat-cow
cat_cow.instructions: On hands and knees, slowly round the back up towards the ceiling, then let it sink while lifting the chest. Move with your breath.

pigeon_stretch.name: Pigeon stretch
pigeon_stretch.instructions: From all fours, bring one knee forward behind the hand with the shin angled across, the back leg long. Sink the hips and hold. Do both sides.
